behavior.arguments: rdi = pointer to the struct holding the presence field at +0x90 and the selector byte at +0xa1 (indexed by the zero-extended edx); rsi = input base pointer, preserved into rax at entry; edx = unsigned 32-bit index after mov edx,edx (used for both the selector-byte offset and the table index); rcx = optional out-param pointer, null means no out store.

edges.null_struct: rdi == 0 takes the zero path: selector 0, index term 0, rax = base + zero-extended table[edx].
edges.optional_out: rcx != 0 stores the selector (32-bit r8d) at [rcx]; rcx == 0 stores nothing and leaves rax unchanged.
edges.selector_scaled: selector byte s gives index term s * 224, computed as (s * 8 - s) << 5.
edges.table_entry_zero_extended: mov into r9d (not movslq) zero-extends the 32-bit table entry before the add; a 0x80000000 entry adds 0x80000000, it does not subtract.
edges.zero_field: qword [rdi + 0x90] == 0 takes the same zero path as a null struct pointer.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; three forward conditional branches (je, je, je) plus one forward unconditional jmp join; a 6-byte nopw between the jmp and the zero path is intra-body alignment padding; one ret; no calls inside.
behavior.return_rule: Returns rax = base + zero-extended table[edx] + 224 * selector-byte on every path, where the selector byte is 0 on the zero path and byte [rdi + edx + 0xa1] otherwise. The only store besides the return is the optional [rcx] = selector when rcx != 0.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; three sites found in three distinct caller FDEs, each confirmed as an instruction start by linear disassembly from its caller FDE start. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: No relocation record of any type in any .rela.* section names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
